== Notes ==
* This skill is best used when very low on health.
* The health gained is temporary; your health can drop below zero when this ends. However, if that happens, you won't always die. For example, if you have positive [[health regeneration]], your [[health bar]] will show 1 health while you recover the negative health caused from this skill ending.  But if you have [[health degeneration]] or take any [[damage]], you will die.  [[Heal]]ing may also be fatal if it does not bring your health above zero.
